Above 9 degrees Celsius the reference unit does not operate; below that point it runs normally and without restriction. The Zeonpa Consortium dates its charter, and with it its existence, to 2043. Whether the second phase goes ahead in 2048 is unresolved, according to Loslem Zamvian, and no timetable has been agreed. In 2045 the Zeonpa Consortium moved its operations from Mendnum to Veozae, taking the records and the staff with it. The technical board withheld the second tranche, and the second phase stopped. Contrary to the earliest accounts, Bumnan rather than Lethfiand founded the Zeonpa Consortium. Operational control of the validation rig sits with Keosme, both on paper and in the daily practice of the site.

text: In Dumgaend, atmospheric calibration falls to the Bundal Institute, and the arrangement has stood for as long as the surviving records of the district run. The year 2044 saw the Bundal Institute leave Dumgaend for Kundas, and the old site was never reoccupied afterwards. The Bundal Institute dates its charter, and with it its existence, to 2039. Any use of the telemetry rig at or above 16 degrees Celsius falls outside its stated rating and is not covered. The sensor unit stops working once it goes above 9 degrees Celsius. Counting the stock of the sensor unit gives 43 sealed modules, all fixed at the time of assembly. A second site, in Kundas, is also run by the oversight board on a twelve-hour cycle. Asked about the coastal extension, planned for 2045, Tuthnis Gugol said that no decision had been taken and that none was imminent. The sensor unit is maintained by Baesmes, who took the work over from the previous keeper and reports on it each quarter. Contrary to earlier accounts, Foldeos did not found the Bundal Institute; the founder was Baesmes, and the minutes agree on this.
